tokens.name: cornsilk
tokens.usage: Palette 'Cornsilk'. The lightest ground; page background in the light theme (`bg`).

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: The warm off-white panel behind the logo sheet and the light ink on dark and teal grounds. Raised surfaces in the light theme (`bg-raised`); cream logo ink on dark-coffee, dark-cyan and rosy-copper grounds.

tokens.name: rosy-copper
tokens.usage: Palette 'Rosy Copper'. The brand's loud colour: bread print, large display type, marks. Text on cornsilk only at 24px and up (4.1:1); pair small text with `on-accent`.

tokens.name: dark-coffee
tokens.usage: Palette 'Dark Coffee'. Body text on cornsilk and cream (13:1, 11:1); the dark ground in the dark theme.

tokens.name: crust-brown
tokens.usage: The brown of the cookie bags and the brown logo ink on cream and ash-grey. Secondary text on cornsilk and cream; raised surface in the dark theme.

tokens.name: ash-grey
tokens.usage: Palette 'Ash Grey'. A calm sage ground for the brown logo, and secondary text in the dark theme.

tokens.name: dark-cyan
tokens.usage: Palette 'Dark Cyan'. The croissant teal: croissant bags and cream or sage logo ink. Text on cornsilk only at 24px and up (3.6:1); never body copy.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The black logo ink on cream. Small text on rosy-copper and dark-cyan fills (4.8:1, 5.5:1).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background in each theme. Text on it: `fg`, `fg-secondary`.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and table rows on `bg`. Text on it: `fg`, `fg-secondary`. `accent` text does not pass on this ground in the dark theme.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on `bg` and `bg-raised` (11:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: fg-secondary
tokens.usage: Captions, labels and secondary text on `bg` and `bg-raised` (7:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Borders on inputs and controls and focus rings; 3:1 or better on `bg` and `bg-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and tile outlines only; it carries no meaning, so it may sit below 3:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Display type 24px and up, rules, the bread category and large marks on `bg` (4.1:1 light, 3.1:1 dark). Not for small text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Small text on an `accent` or `dark-cyan` fill (4.8:1 and 5.5:1). Cream text on these fills is allowed only at 24px and up or bold 19px and up.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button and selected controls.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on an `action` fill (13:1).

tokens.name: category-bread
tokens.usage: Bread titles and captions at 24px and up, matching the copper print on kraft bags.

tokens.name: category-cookies
tokens.usage: Cookie titles and captions, matching the cream print on chocolate-brown bags (brown on light grounds, cream on dark).

tokens.name: category-croissants
tokens.usage: Croissant titles at 24px and up (3.6:1 on both `bg` values), matching the teal bags.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Category titles and posters. Capitals only, one or two lines.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Small headings; the smallest size the display face is used.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Product captions, set in capitals with wide tracking, as under the photos and in 'BAKERY'.

spacing.note: No spacing scale came with the brand files; this is a 4px starter scale.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps between a label and its icon.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between caption and image; compact padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and default gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a row.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a category title and its photos.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

radius.note: No radius came with the brand files: bags and photos are square-cornered, so square is the default.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Photos, bags, tiles and cards.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and buttons, if softened.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags only.
